state.rule: A period accepts one exact pending root at its own revision. Invariant: one period binds the exact approved plan and expected population; range changes are admitted one pending root at a time at the exact revision; the opening is the period's own logical operation. A rejected or canceled opening is fenced and never reopens.

code_behavior.envelope: AcceptOpening and AcceptAmendment now refuse (Validation, no event) when the affected owner, expected-revision owner or first owner is not the period stream, or the first response schema is not first-response-descriptor.v1; previously such a fact was raised and the aggregate's own replay guard threw on replay.
code_behavior.amendment_before_start: AcceptAmendment on a period with no applied header returns a missing-record failure with no event, even while the opening is pending; the pending-root conflict check is only reachable after the opening applied.
code_behavior.second_opening: A second AcceptOpening after an opening was accepted (pending, rejected, or applied) returns Conflict, no event.
code_behavior.test_fence: Test: accept opening, reject it via calendar proof, reject again, then accept opening again. Expected: first reject succeeds, later reject and re-accept refused, exactly two pending events, no pending root, revision 0.

envelope_refusal.instructions: For state.code_behavior.envelope, what should the aggregate do with an acceptance whose frozen envelope its replay guard would reject?

criteria.refuse_no_event: Refuse the command and append nothing, since a fact that cannot replay corrupts the stream.
criteria.raise_and_let_replay_throw: Raise the event and let replay reject it.
criteria.needs_source_resolution: The model does not decide this.

amendment_order.instructions: For state.code_behavior.amendment_before_start, is refusing an amendment while the opening is still pending (not applied) consistent with the rule?

criteria.refuse: Refuse: a range amendment needs an applied period; the pending opening is the only admitted root.
criteria.admit_queue: Admit the amendment behind the pending opening.
criteria.needs_source_resolution: The model does not decide this.

fence_test.instructions: The test in state.code_behavior.test_fence asserts the rule that a rejected opening is fenced forever and creates no extra fact.

envelope_premise.instructions: Refusing a malformed acceptance envelope before raising any event is consistent with the rule in state.rule that a period accepts one exact pending root.
